name: Entries per vertical
query: MATCH (e:Entry)-[:IN_VERTICAL]->(v:Vertical) RETURN v.name AS vertical, count(e) AS entries ORDER BY entries DESC

name: Entries per lifecycle stage
query: MATCH (e:Entry)-[:SURFACES_AT]->(s:Stage) RETURN s.name AS stage, count(e) AS entries ORDER BY entries DESC

name: Top tags
query: MATCH (e:Entry)-[:TAGGED]->(t:Tag) RETURN t.name AS tag, count(e) AS entries ORDER BY entries DESC LIMIT 25

name: Most-referenced entries
query: MATCH (e:Entry)<-[:RELATED_TO]-(x) RETURN e.entry_id AS entry, count(x) AS references ORDER BY references DESC LIMIT 20

name: Entries by complexity
query: MATCH (e:Entry) RETURN coalesce(e.complexity, '(none)') AS complexity, count(*) AS entries ORDER BY entries DESC

name: Gaps - no vertical
query: MATCH (e:Entry) WHERE NOT (e)-[:IN_VERTICAL]->() RETURN e.entry_id AS entry ORDER BY entry

name: Gaps - orphan entries
query: MATCH (e:Entry) WHERE NOT (e)-[:RELATED_TO]-() RETURN e.entry_id AS entry ORDER BY entry

name: GDS 2 - PageRank (central entries)
query: CALL gds.pageRank.stream('aidlc_rel') YIELD nodeId, score RETURN gds.util.asNode(nodeId).entry_id AS entry, score ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 20

name: GDS 3 - Louvain communities
query: CALL gds.louvain.stream('aidlc_rel') YIELD nodeId, communityId RETURN communityId, collect(gds.util.asNode(nodeId).entry_id) AS entries ORDER BY size(entries) DESC
